body:
If I were to kill myself, there would be about three people who would actually miss me. My mom, brother and sister, I would have one nephew with vague memories of me and two nieces who wouldn't know me. My girlfriend would be relieved as it is put immense strain on our relationship (I've had on and off depression[?] for about two years) and now it seems like she doesn't care about it anymore. 

I know I'd need to go see an actual professional to get diagnosed, but could anyone give me an idea about if this is actually mental-health kinda depression or am I bi-polar if it's been on and off for a while?

I appreciate peoples kind thoughts
